listings.description: Oscar Platinum is clean, fresh, and effortlessly modern. It opens with a bright, crisp energy that feels instantly uplifting, giving the fragrance a sharp and refined first impression. As it develops, it softens into a smooth, balanced heart that carries a quiet warmth. As it settles, a subtle woody trail lingers on the skin - elegant, long-lasting, and easy to wear. It leaves behind a refined presence that feels natural rather than loud. Simple, sophisticated, and quietly confident, Oscar Platinum is made for those who prefer understated impact over excess. TOP NOTES Vetiver – Black pepper – Pink Pepper – Basil MID NOTES Ginger – Grapefruit – Timur – Musk BASE NOTES Amber – Patchouli – Cedar.

Ghali Imperial is smooth, refined, and quietly bold. It opens clean and elegant, then develops into a warm, slightly powdery character that feels rich but controlled. The scent stays close yet noticeable, giving off a confident and polished presence throughout the day. As it settles, it leaves a soft, woody trail that feels classic and modern at the same time. Simple, masculine, and effortlessly sophisticated. TOP NOTES Iris – Bergamot – Cardamom MID NOTES Amber – Musk BASE NOTES Patchouli – Musk – Vetiver .

Ghali Elegant is soft, radiant, and effortlessly feminine. It opens with a gentle brightness that feels fresh and inviting, then moves into a smooth, slightly sweet warmth. The scent feels balanced and graceful, with a light floral touch that adds elegance without being overpowering. As it settles, a creamy, comforting base lingers on the skin, leaving a subtle yet lasting impression. Simple, modern, and easy to wear every day. TOP NOTES Orange – Pear – Bergamot MID NOTES Rose – Orange Flower – Saffron – Musk BASE NOTES Wood – Amber – Vanilla – Sandalwood .

Ode to Rose Royale is bright, elegant, and gently feminine. It opens with a soft fruity freshness that feels light and uplifting, setting a graceful tone. As it develops, a smooth floral character comes through, adding a touch of softness and charm without being too strong. The scent settles into a warm, slightly creamy base that feels comforting and balanced. Clean, modern, and easy to wear, this fragrance is perfect for everyday elegance. TOP NOTES Orange – Peach – Pear MID NOTES Peony – Musk – Violet BASE NOTES Vanilla – Amber – Vetiver .

Ode to Rose Bella is delicate, romantic, and gently sweet. It opens with a delicate floral touch, lifted by a subtle fruity brightness that feels inviting and modern. As it develops, a light warmth adds depth, giving the scent a smooth and slightly playful character. It settles into a soft, comforting trail that stays close to the skin while still being noticeable. Elegant, feminine, and easy to wear for any moment. TOP NOTES Rose – Cherry MID NOTES Pink pepper – Tonka Bean BASE NOTES Musk – Vanilla – Patchouli .

A modern expression of confidence and effortless sophistication, Modhesh Noble is designed for men who move with quiet power. This fragrance opens with a vibrant, energetic freshness that immediately feels polished and contemporary. As it evolves, the heart reveals a smooth, elegant character - clean, comforting, and irresistibly refined, creating a perfectly balanced signature that feels both intimate and commanding. The dry-down settles into a warm, sensual trail that lingers beautifully on the skin, leaving an impression of depth, strength, and understated luxury. Modhesh Noble is more than a fragrance. It is a statement of modern masculinity, crafted for everyday elegance and elevated moments - bold yet refined, timeless yet unmistakably current. TOP NOTES Bergamot – Cardamom – Black Currant – Ginger MID NOTES Orange Blossom – Musk - Lavender BASE NOTES Patchouli – Amber .

A journey of abundance allure, this fragrance is a timeless captivating blend adding an irresistible aura to your personality. The tropical fruity juice of pineapple and fresh notes of hyacinth are spiced with pink pepper. The floral heart is infused with a warm mix of patchouli and ambroxan, with enticing accents of musk. A vibrant mix of fresh and oriental notes, this fragrance provokes a sense of freedom and enchantment in the wearer. . TOP NOTE Pineapple, Hyacinth, Pink Pepper MID NOTE Iris, Jasmine, Musk BASE NOTE Vanilla, Patchouli, Ambroxan .

A bold and exotic fragrance that harmoniously blends the opulence of agarwood with the vibrant sweetness of passion fruit. This unique combination creates an unexpected olfactory journey, offering a fresh take on traditional oud blends. Inspired by the contrasting sensations of lush, tropical gardens and deep, mysterious forests, this scent captures the essence of luxury and adventure. Suitable for evening wear or special occasions, this perfume exudes elegance and confidence, making it an ideal choice for anyone looking to make a statement.. TOP NOTE Passion Fruit - Rose MID NOTE Agarwood BASE NOTE Patchouli - Benzoin.

Discover the allure of “Reserved Oud,” a unisex fragrance with a hint of Oud, blending sophistication with oriental richness. . TOP NOTE Agarwood, wild Lavender MID NOTE Vanilla, musk, powdery BASE NOTE Amber, sweet, aromatic . .

This exhilarating fragrance is a symphony of lavender and bergamot top notes, with middle notes of agarwood and cedarwood and rich undertones of leather, amber, and musk. . TOP NOTE Saffron - Lavender - Bergamot - Artemisia MID NOTE Agarwood (Oud) - Geranium - Lily-of-the-Valley - Cedar - Cypress BASE NOTE Leather -Amber - Musk . .

The base is anchored by the luxurious leather creating a sense of warmth and opulence. This exquisite fragrance is ideal for those who seek a distinctive and memorable scent that exudes confidence and elegance. . Top Notes . Bergamot - Mandarin - Pink Pepper . Middle Notes . White Amber - Agarwood - Davana . Base Notes . Musk - Fresh Spicy - Leather .
